steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Choreographic devices are tools used to develop and structure movement material | Key Fact: Repetition involves repeating a movement or phrase to create emphasis or recognition | Key Fact: Unison means all dancers performing the same movement at the same time | Key Fact: Canon is when dancers perform the same movement one after another in sequence

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from choreographic devices, and one past-paper question.
